page.overview:
Who is Marith Riven?

Marith Riven is a Murandian Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah., Marith Riven}}

Marith is 5'6" tall and has not yet achieved the ageless look.

Marith is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

Marith is 32 years old. She was born in 968 NE and went to the White Tower in 984 NE. Marith spent eight years as a novice and seven as Accepted. She was raised to the shawl in 999 NE.
